result.brief: 提出 A2D：无需训练，将自回归后训练权重更新直接迁移/组合到扩散语言模型，提升指令跟随、数学与代码能力，并分析权重正交性与表征对齐。
result.reason: Studies diffusion language models, weight-space composition of AR post-training updates, and representation alignment—directly relevant to continuous/diffusion language modeling and latent representation transfer.
